dedupe_keys.name: satellite remote sensing dataset for urban climate in bergen and prague turban d09

description: A Czech Academy of Sciences researcher publishes processed satellite layers for urban land-surface-temperature calculations in Bergen and Prague. Zenodo supplies an archive under CC BY 4.0. The record describes Landsat-8 and Landsat-9 scenes, cloud masks, top-of-atmosphere reflectance, vegetation indices, fractional vegetation cover and land-surface emissivity steps. These rasters can inform urban heat and surface-energy simulations for buildings and green-space planning. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this two-city processing set. Coverage is the selected scenes in Norway and Czechia, not continuous air-temperature observations or a city-wide weather station network. A limitation is that cloud screening, emissivity assumptions and the split UTM zones for Bergen affect comparison between scenes; land-surface temperature is not the same as occupant heat exposure. The original Landsat data are credited separately. No ZIP was downloaded or temperature calculation reproduced.
